title: PetMonitor
description: Pet Monitoring system for cats and dogs

title: Laser-Guided Insect Detection and Tracking Using Raspberry Pi
description: This project combines computer vision and robotics to detect and track insects using a Raspberry Pi camera and laser module. Classic vision techniques to detected insects and laser, while proportional control mechanisms guide the robot's head and movements for precise tracking.

title: Automated Checkout System for Corporate Cafeterias
description: Cafeteria checkout inefficiencies, exacerbated by post-COVID employee presence, can be addressed with AI and IoT innovations. These innovations streamline operations, reduce wait times, and improve employee satisfaction and productivity.

title: Garment Pattern Device
description: As a DIY fashion producer, I thought the design process for creating properly-fitting paper patterns could be streamlined. I created a system to collect garment measurements and create a custom printable pattern for a piece of clothing specific to an individual's proportions.

title: WiFi Sensing for Fall Detection
description: Did you know that WiFi chips can sense their surroundings in a sonar-like fashion? This project uses the built in WiFi chip on an inexpensive Raspberry Pi to detect when a person nearby falls down, to e.g. help the elderly - like Life Alert, but automatic and wearable-free!

title: Reliability Optimization and Observability System (ROOS)
description: This project enabled request mapping, automated alerts via Azure-Jira, and SLO data storage, improving observability and reliability for Medline's E-Commerce platform.

title: Cama-l Pack Moisture Monitoring Solutions
description: The Cama team developed several plant moisture monitoring solutions using Raspberry Pi and Arduino. We created several different dashboards including web hosted options and a custom cell phone application that connects to the Pi through Bluetooth.

title: DoorWAI
description: DoorWAI is an intelligent doorbell system that combines real-time video monitoring, two-way communication, and AI-powered visitor detection.

title: CS437 Smart Security System
description: Security system utilizing computer vision for person detection.

title: cAIms: Facial Recognition Alarm System
description: A Camera Monitoring System with AI in the Middle

title: PiDerm - Low cost skin disease detection
description: PiDerm is an ultra low cost Deep Learning based Skin disease detection product that can be generalized to any model ensemble. The Raspberry Pi and web interface allow for easy viewing of patient data and also model statistics at very low latencies.

title: LibraryWaze
description: We present LibraryWaze, a Library occupancy monitoring IoT solution designed to help students efficiently plan their study sessions and library visits by providing real-time information and updates on available study spaces.
